A verify answer that failed validation stopped the first attempt; fixed (optional stages never fail a build) and Continue finished it

features.title: Any coding agent can write a course, through files, a CLI or an MCP server, and import it
features.user_visible_behavior: A coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, any other) writes a course either as a folder by docs/authoring-courses.md and the write-course skill, or through the coursewright MCP server (rules as tools/resources/prompt, save tools that check each piece, check_course, import_course). `make course-check` reports errors and teaching warnings with file paths; `make course-import` or POST /api/courses/import saves it as a ready course in the Library, indexed for the tutor, with a 'Your map so far' diagram per lesson; --replace updates it.
